title: 'Add warm-up sets' ignores the member's machine and cable step
what: A member who sets Machine and cable steps to 5 kg gets suggested weights on a 5 kg grid, but the warm-up sets for a machine or cable exercise are still rounded to the library step, usually 2.5 kg. A 55 kg working set gets a 32.5 kg warm-up that the stack cannot make.
expected: Warm-up sets on a machine or cable exercise use the same step the suggested weights use: the member's chosen machine and cable step.
who: members who set a machine and cable step
how_often: every warm-up on a machine or cable exercise once a step is chosen
fix_line: Round machine and cable warm-ups to the chosen machine step, as the suggested weights do

title: A shared routine shows different rep ranges from the ones the member sees
what: When the member picks a Rep range other than Match my goal (for example Strength), every routine page shows that range (for example 3 x 3-6). Sharing the routine as text, or as a file, sends the old stored range instead (for example 3 x 8-12). The friend or trainer reads a plan the member is not doing.
expected: The shared text says the same rep ranges the member's routine page shows, or says plainly that the ranges follow the sender's own setting.
who: members who changed Rep range and share a routine
how_often: every share once Rep range is not Match my goal
fix_line: Write the rep range the routine page shows into the shared text and file

title: Reminders first suggest Monday, Wednesday and Friday even when the member set a weekly goal
what: When a new member turns reminders on before 2 weeks of history, the days are taken from the plan, else Monday, Wednesday and Friday. The member's own Weekly goal (for example 5 workouts a week) is not used, so they get 3 reminders a week for a 5-day goal until they change the days by hand.
expected: With no history yet, the first reminder days follow the member's weekly goal when one is set, before falling back to the plan or Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
who: new members who set a weekly goal
how_often: first time reminders are turned on with little history
fix_line: Use the weekly goal to spread the first reminder days when there is no history
